posts.body: the important part is how many cells the sprote has, and where they are placed - VXA needs 3x4 cells for a single sprite in a grid.

posts.author: Zahawk
posts.body:
Here is a template to overlay your sprite, resize the template until it fits your 220x220px, just get your sprite to lineup like the RTP's $BigMonster1 (refer to RTP's Actor1, etc. layout if you want to include a walking animation). Finally rename the IMG as $NAMEHERE where the $ is important, and place it into the Graphics/Characters Folder of your project.
220px is ~7 tiles wide so if the IMG has the same layout as $BigMonster1 then the result will be just over 2 tiles wide ingame.
Edit: If 220px is the cell size then using the picture event command would probably be better.
